observational_status: matched four-case, four-frame normalized-native M3D-C1 numerical response diagnostic; no experimental machine shot, calibrated physical current integral, causal controller-in-loop demonstration or validated experimental shot handoff
successful_milestone: Four native matched cases completed with exact zero-field equivalence (0 <= 1e-12), consistent 1004-element mesh, and opposing signed jphi response lobes. At t=0.03, e[2]-weighted cancellation was 79.53% negative / 77.18% positive; R*e[2]-weighted cancellation was 78.69% negative / 77.43% positive. The partial cancellation survives axisymmetric R weighting within 0.85 percentage points, an informative robustness milestone, not physical current conservation.
interpretation: Opposing-lobe jphi response and partial cancellation are supported under two uncalibrated positive mesh weightings. Net signed residuals remain nonzero and odd-sign symmetry residual reaches 80.11% at t=0.03, weakening exact balance and sign-symmetric interpretations. R*e[2] is not independently validated area/current quadrature. A matched time-step refinement is warranted to test whether this response is a coarse-time-step artifact before promoting interpretation.
followup_scope: One bounded normalized-native M3D-C1 matched dt-halving diagnostic (dt=0.005 vs 0.01, six vs three steps to same t=0.03), preserving source-mode 4, amplitudes, gate, mesh, solver physics and frozen gates; compare e[2] and R*e[2] signed-lobe cancellation at aligned times; no calibrated physical quadrature or convergence claim.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; exact zero-source field equivalence is not experimental-shot-to-native equilibrium/profile handoff
